items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Buddy Bowden's blues' and Interviewee responds about 'he had it in his head' referring to Jelly Roll Morton, not Buddy Bowden.

ctx.x: And just every once in a while, you know, just that.
What about, this, Buddy Bowden's blues? Jelly must have written that or must have had it in his head long before he had it.
he had it in his head. Never, the, the little strain, it was a very short strain. That was it. See?
